pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What should we never throw into rivers? (1 mark)
   A. Rainwater
   B. Clean leaves
   C. Rain
   D. Plastic and waste

2. What does maha mean in Mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Small
   B. New
   C. Great
   D. Old

3. Which two elements are needed for a crop to grow well? (1 mark)
   A. Fire and metal
   B. Metal and stone
   C. Space and salt
   D. Water and earth

4. What do the words nar and simha mean in Narsimha? (1 mark)
   A. King and queen
   B. Sun and moon
   C. Man and lion
   D. Water and fire

5. What is an Avtar? (1 mark)
   A. A daily prayer
   B. A kind of tree
   C. A holy river
   D. A form in which God is believed to come to earth

6. Who was Prahlad? (1 mark)
   A. A Jain monk
   B. The young son of Hiranyakashipu who loved Vishnu
   C. A river
   D. A Sikh Guru

7. What did the wise men say about the swan? (1 mark)
   A. It should be sold
   B. It belongs to the king
   C. The one who saves a life has more right to it
   D. The one who shoots it owns it

8. Who wrote the Ramayan in Sanskrit? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Arjan Dev
   B. Sage Valmiki
   C. Guru Nanak
   D. Sigala

9. What is a prayer? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of meal
   B. A sport
   C. A way of talking to God
   D. A map

10. What is the murti in a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. A seat
   B. A lamp
   C. A statue of God
   D. A book

11. How should we say the Gayatri Mantra? (1 mark)
   A. While running
   B. Slowly and clearly, sitting quietly
   C. While eating
   D. Shouting

12. What does Asteya include besides not stealing things? (1 mark)
   A. Not using another's time or ideas without asking
   B. Not walking
   C. Not smiling
   D. Not eating

13. What is the purpose of a lost and found corner? (1 mark)
   A. To keep the items forever
   B. To keep found items until owners claim them
   C. To sell lost items
   D. To hide them

14. What should passengers do with rubbish? (1 mark)
   A. Drop it on the road
   B. Leave it on the seat
   C. Keep it until you find a bin
   D. Throw it out of the window

15. Which king is known for always telling the truth in a Hindu story? (1 mark)
   A. Hiranyakashipu
   B. Ravan
   C. Harishchandra
   D. Kansa

16. Which Jain teaching means not stealing? (1 mark)
   A. Asteya
   B. Aparigraha
   C. Ahimsa
   D. Satya

17. Which organisation set International Yoga Day? (1 mark)
   A. A local school
   B. The United Nations
   C. A school
   D. A bank

18. In Kapaal Bhaati, which part of the breath is quick? (1 mark)
   A. The breath in
   B. Neither
   C. The breath out
   D. Both are held

19. Which three things does yoga join? (1 mark)
   A. Body, breath and mind
   B. Water, soil and air
   C. Rivers, trees and fire
   D. Books, pens and paper

20. In which year was International Yoga Day first celebrated? (1 mark)
   A. 2015
   B. 2030
   C. 2005
   D. 1990

21. Which is a mistake in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Breathing slowly
   B. Holding the breath for too long
   C. Working with a teacher
   D. Stopping if unwell

22. What does Paramatma mean? (1 mark)
   A. A holy river
   B. A daily prayer
   C. A festival
   D. The Supreme Soul

23. Which principle is about the Supreme Soul? (1 mark)
   A. Prani Daya
   B. Paramatma
   C. Prarthana
   D. Punarjanam

24. Which mistake is common about Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. Knowing it is in Phalguna
   B. Thinking it is the same as Diwali
   C. Knowing about fasting
   D. Knowing it is for Shiva

25. Which festival comes first in the year in the lesson's timeline? (1 mark)
   A. Jamhuri Day
   B. Maha Shivratri
   C. Madaraka Day
   D. Paryushan

26. Paryushan Parva is a festival of which faith? (1 mark)
   A. Jainism
   B. Buddhism
   C. Hinduism
   D. Sikhism

27. How can we help a friend who uses a wheelchair at a festival? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh
   B. Help them to move safely and include them
   C. Leave them alone
   D. Ignore them

28. Which festival in the lesson is celebrated near the middle of the year on 1 June? (1 mark)
   A. Maha Shivratri
   B. Madaraka Day
   C. Yoga Day
   D. Paryushan

29. Which is a good food safety rule? (1 mark)
   A. Leave food in the sun
   B. Wash hands before eating
   C. Eat with dirty hands
   D. Share used cups

30. Which mistake is common about Madaraka Day? (1 mark)
   A. Knowing the flag is raised
   B. Knowing it is for patriots
   C. Knowing it is 1 June
   D. Thinking it is Independence Day

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain four lessons we learn from the Ramayan. (4 marks)

32. Give two safety rules for yoga. (2 marks)

33. Give two signs of integrity. (2 marks)

34. Explain why a child should understand the meaning of a prayer. (4 marks)

35. Give two of Parshvanath's four rules. (2 marks)

36. Explain how you can show integrity when using the internet. (3 marks)

37. Explain four things a passenger should do when alighting. (4 marks)

38. Name the four Purusharthas. (2 marks)

39. Explain why balance is important in the four Purusharthas. (5 marks)

40. Draw and label a simple Mandir. Name four features you would show. (4 marks)

41. Describe how to do Sasankasana. (4 marks)

42. Explain how the story of Prahlad shows faith in Paramatma. (3 marks)

43. Name the two Buddhist scriptures in this lesson. (2 marks)

44. State two reasons why trees and plants are important. (2 marks)

45. Give two lessons of the Bal Kaand. (2 marks)

46. List three things you should do before starting yoga. (3 marks)

47. Give the date and origin of International Yoga Day. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Plastic and waste
   Waste harms water and living things.

2. C — Great
   Maha means great and bhoot means element.

3. D — Water and earth
   Soil and water help a crop to grow.

4. C — Man and lion
   Nar means man and simha means lion.

5. D — A form in which God is believed to come to earth
   An Avtar is a coming down of God to protect goodness.

6. B — The young son of Hiranyakashipu who loved Vishnu
   Prahlad stayed faithful to Vishnu.

7. C — The one who saves a life has more right to it
   They said saving life is a greater right.

8. B — Sage Valmiki
   Valmiki is honoured as its author.

9. C — A way of talking to God
   We thank God and ask for wisdom.

10. C — A statue of God
   The murti is a statue or image of God.

11. B — Slowly and clearly, sitting quietly
   Calm and clear.

12. A — Not using another's time or ideas without asking
   It includes respecting others' things and ideas.

13. B — To keep found items until owners claim them
   Owners can claim their things.

14. C — Keep it until you find a bin
   Keeping the environment clean is good conduct.

15. C — Harishchandra
   Harishchandra kept his word.

16. A — Asteya
   Asteya is non-stealing.

17. B — The United Nations
   The UN chose the day in 2014.

18. C — The breath out
   The breath is pushed out in short pulls.

19. A — Body, breath and mind
   Yoga joins these three.

20. A — 2015
   It was first celebrated in 2015.

21. B — Holding the breath for too long
   Never force the breath.

22. D — The Supreme Soul
   It is the highest soul, God.

23. B — Paramatma
   Paramatma is God.

24. B — Thinking it is the same as Diwali
   They are different festivals.

25. B — Maha Shivratri
   It is in February or March.

26. A — Jainism
   It is the main Jain festival.

27. B — Help them to move safely and include them
   Inclusion is important.

28. B — Madaraka Day
   1 June is mid-year.

29. B — Wash hands before eating
   Hygiene is important.

30. D — Thinking it is Independence Day
   Independence is 12 December.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep promises, respect elders, be humble, do not be greedy for power, love your brothers and sisters, and be courageous (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Practise with a teacher, wear loose clothes, do it on a mat, do not do it after a big meal, stop if you feel dizzy (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: Telling the truth, keeping promises, returning what is not yours, not cheating (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Understanding makes the prayer come from the heart, helps us remember it, and helps us live by its message. Rushing without meaning makes it only a habit.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point, up to 4.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ahimsa, Satya, Asteya or Aparigraha (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct rule.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ask permission before using a device, do not copy another's work, do not send unkind or untrue messages, and keep personal details private (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: Wait for the vehicle to stop, take belongings, get off one at a time, look out for traffic, thank the driver (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: Dharma, Artha, Kama, Moksha.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each.

39. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wealth and wishes are good but must follow Dharma. Without balance, chasing money or wishes can lead to cheating and harm, while Dharma keeps us honest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for balance, 2 marks for Dharma guiding the others, 2 marks for an example.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: A hall, a spire, a door with steps, a bell or flag, and the murti room (any four labelled).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct feature labelled.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: Start in Vajra Asana, breathe in and raise the arms, breathe out and bend forward, rest the forehead on the mat with arms stretched forward, breathe calmly and come up slowly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four correct steps.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Prahlad believed God is everywhere, kept praying when his father was angry, and was protected.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Dhammapada and the Sigalovada Sutta.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: They give oxygen, shade, food and medicine; their leaves are used in worship (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Respect for parents and teachers, love between brothers, courage to protect others, obedience to wise guidance (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wear loose clothes, prepare a mat, have an empty stomach, find a quiet place, meet with a teacher (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: 21 June, chosen by the United Nations.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the date, 1 mark for the United Nations.
